game.name: Tekken 6 (Europe)(En,Ja,Fr,De,Es,It,Ko,Ru)(Rev 1)
game.desc: The Tekken fighting franchise is back on Xbox 360 with new characters and game modes. After the last tournament, Jin Kazama became the head of the Mishima Zaibatsu company and uses the special forces for his personal propaganda. His actions lead to riots and wars between nations. The G Corporation offers a bounty to anyone who can bring Jin Kazama to them alive. Let the battle begin...
